name: CP2K
description: Builds CP2K 2026.2 with the selected MPI, FFTW, ScaLAPACK, OpenBLAS and its checksum-verified toolchain. The CUDA base uses NVHPC to match the SDK MPI Fortran modules. ELPA, HDF5 and large-system libraries are optional.

gpuVersion.description: CP2K GPU target (kernels tuned for it; PTX is embedded, so newer GPUs JIT-compile); requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU version.

elpa.description: Use ELPA as the eigensolver; needs the elpa Feature.

hdf5.description: Enable HDF5 output; needs the hdf5 Feature.

largeSystems.description: Build COSMA, SpFFT, SpLA, SIRIUS (plane waves; needs hdf5), spglib and libvori with CP2K's toolchain (GPU builds when gpuVersion is set).

cmakeArgs.description: Extra CMake arguments, space separated, applied last.
